scope_limits: The tracial product construction uses specified faithful normal tracial states; the normal tensor-map theorems require neither states nor traces.
Normal homomorphism and completely positive tensor maps do not imply that arbitrary commuting subalgebras give an ambient spatial tensor decomposition.
Modular-weight, core, centralizer, cohomology and full factor-classification results retain their own hypotheses.
